events.title: EcoSTEM Changemakers Lab : Session 2 - Clean The Beach Protect The Blue
events.description: Awareness & Beach Clean-Up was an environmental action organized at Qaraiya Beach, Monastir, as part of the UNESCO–SIGHT Ambassador Program. IEEE volunteers collaborated with Notre Grand Bleu and Lycée Hédi Khefacha in Monastir to conduct environmental awareness activities and a large-scale beach clean-up

events.title: EcoSTEM Changemakers Lab : Session 1 - Youth & Women Driving Sustainable Innovation
events.description: The first session of the EcoSTEM Changemakers Lab was an online educational and capacity-building event focused on empowering women and young people through STEM and sustainable innovation. Participants explored IEEE SIGHT, the Sustainable Development Goals, Women in Engineering, artificial intelligence for sustainable communities, and design-thinking approaches. The session encouraged participants to identify community challenges and transform them into innovative project ideas

events.title: 3ich IEEE
events.description: 3ich IEEE was an outdoor camping experience held in Jendouba, bringing together IEEE members, students, volunteers, and community engagement enthusiasts. The activity promoted well-being, teamwork, and personal development through outdoor challenges, shared experiences, and collaboration in a natural environment.

events.title: UIUX4Good: Creating Purpose Driven Experiences
events.description: UIUX4Good was a design-focused workshop introducing participants to UI/UX principles while emphasizing inclusive and human-centered technology. Participants explored how research, user experience, accessibility, and interface design can improve solutions developed for social and humanitarian purposes. The workshop encouraged students to place community needs and user experience at the center of technological innovation.

events.title: React4Good
events.description: React4Good was a technical workshop combining web development education with the Tech4Good philosophy. Participants were introduced to React.js concepts and learned how modern web technologies can be used to develop solutions addressing social and humanitarian challenges. The workshop helped students improve their technical skills while encouraging them to design technology with positive societal impact.

events.title: A Brief History
events.description: A Brief History was an inspiring session exploring the evolution of IEEE SIGHT in Tunisia, delivered by Rima Fathallah and Med Yasser Bdioui. The session highlighted SIGHT’s mission, key milestones, and humanitarian impact while showing participants how technology and volunteer engagement can contribute to sustainable community development.

events.title: Podcast 2.0 – Episode 2: Notre Grand Bleu
events.description: The second episode of Podcast 2.0 featured Notre Grand Bleu, a Tunisian environmental organization committed to protecting marine ecosystems. The discussion raised awareness about marine pollution, biodiversity conservation, environmental responsibility, and the role of young people in protecting Tunisia’s coastline. The episode also strengthened collaboration between IEEE volunteers and local environmental actors.

events.title: Quick SIGHT – Episode 1: SOS
events.description: Quick SIGHT Episode 1 was a short awareness initiative presenting the mission and impact of SOS activities within the community. The episode helped make humanitarian topics accessible to students while promoting volunteerism, solidarity, and the values of IEEE SIGHT through concise and engaging digital content.

events.title: Podcast 2.0 episode 1 with SOS: Awareness & Impact
events.description: The first episode of Podcast 2.0 highlighted the work and social impact of SOS-related initiatives. The discussion focused on community engagement, volunteering, social responsibility, and the importance of youth participation in supporting vulnerable communities. The episode aimed to inspire students to become more engaged in humanitarian and community-oriented activities.

events.title: IEEE SIGHT Launch Session
events.description: The IEEE SIGHT Launch Session, organized by IEEE SIGHT ISIMM Student Branch in collaboration with IEEE Tunisia Section, introduced participants to the humanitarian technology program, highlighting IEEE SIGHT’s mission, benefits for students and communities, activities in Tunisia and worldwide, and opportunities to engage in technology-for-good initiatives such as Tech4Good, EMPOWER a Billion Lives, EPICS in IEEE, Smart Village, and REACH.

events.title: Info SESSION
events.description: IEEE SIGHT ISIMM hosted its first-ever info-session to engage participants in a comprehensive overview of the chapter’s mission, vision, and values. The session showcased key achievements and milestones, presented current and upcoming projects, and encouraged active participation and collaboration. It aimed to inspire attendees to contribute to impactful humanitarian technology initiatives.

projects.title: Aqua Sentinel autonomous AI-powered underwater monitoring system
projects.description:
Aqua Sentinel is an AI-powered system for continuous and non-invasive marine monitoring. It integrates a BRUV (Baited Remote Underwater Video) system, deep learning (YOLOv8), and a mobile application to automatically detect, classify, and track fish species.

The system analyzes underwater data in real time, helping monitor biodiversity, detect invasive species, and support data-driven decisions for marine conservation.

projects.title: Smart Sign Language Translation Glove
projects.description: The Sign Language Translation Device is a smart glove-based system that converts hand gestures into spoken and displayed messages. Using integrated sensors and an Arduino, finger movements are detected and translated into predefined phrases shown on an LCD screen and a mobile application.

projects.title: Your Safety - Smart Road Safety System
projects.description:
Your Safety is a technology-driven solution that enhances road safety by combining a mobile application, smart speed bumps, and AI-based driver fatigue detection to reduce accidents and improve infrastructure monitoring.
This project aims to address major road safety challenges such as poor infrastructure, reckless driving, and lack of enforcement. It integrates three key components: a mobile app that allows users to report road hazards with GPS and images, smart speed bumps that detect and control speeding vehicles, and an AI system that identifies drowsy drivers in real time.
Aligned with SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure), the project promotes safer and more sustainable communities through an innovative, multi-technology approach.

projects.title: Smart House - Sustainable Water & Energy Solution
projects.description:
The Smart House Project is a sustainable solution that integrates solar-powered water purification and renewable energy systems to provide clean water and eco-friendly energy in rural areas.
This project targets SDG 6 (Clean Water) and SDG 7 (Affordable and Clean Energy) by combining solar energy with water purification technologies. It aims to support rural communities by ensuring access to safe drinking water and reliable, renewable energy while reducing environmental impact.
